thread:
marta: Quick sync — I sketched a phased roadmap for a new effort I'm calling the Cost & Latency Navigator (CLN). Goal: give customers prescriptive actions (batching, caching, quantization) + eval-triggered regression alerts so teams can reduce unit cost without surprising quality drops. TL;DR: three buckets: 1) runtime heuristics (fast wins), 2) recommender (per-workload quant + model recs), 3) eval-triggered alerts + audit logs. Link to deck: https://redwood.example.com/roadmaps/cln :spiral_notepad:

sam: this sounds great. couple Qs: which SLO should we optimize for by default — p95 latency or p99? also do we include mobile/low-memory device heuristics in phase 1 or later?

jun: for the quant recs we need a "quality budget" concept. recommender should return candidate quant settings plus an estimated delta on eval metrics. otherwise customers won't trust it.

ada: ops note — rollout plan needs to be explicit. propose canary (10% traffic) -> regional -> global, with automatic rollback if eval alerts trigger. also need clear fallback to float32 model for safety.

ci-bot: deploy-bot created ticket CLN-42: "CLN roadmap + acceptance criteria" and attached initial checklist. https://tickets.internal/CLN-42 :white_check_mark:

nate: echoing jun — customers (AcmeHealth, PaydayAI) asked for an audit trail: they want to see why a specific recommendation was suggested (metrics, sample prompts, confidence). we should surface the decision rationale in the UI and API.

marta: good call. proposed acceptance criteria (draft):
- surface 5 runtime heuristics documented + automated toggles (e.g., dynamic batching thresholds, prefix KV caching)
- recommender API that returns top-3 suggestions per workload with confidence score and expected token-cost delta
- eval-alert pipeline that fires when a monitored eval shows > 5% regression vs baseline (configurable per-customer)
- audit log for every recommendation (inputs + model/quant config + reason)

sam: 5% regression might be tight early on. suggest default 5% for alerts but initial threshold set to 10% with a migration plan to tighten to 5% after 2 weeks of stable runs. also: add a mobile profile to heuristics (smaller batch sizes, smaller KV cache).

jun: implementation note — proto recommender should run offline against sampled traces first. API shape proposal: POST /v1/recs { "workload_id": "...", "sample_prompts": [...], "metrics": {"concordance":0.9} } -> returns suggestions. quick example config below:
```json
{
  "workload_id": "acme-search",
  "suggestions": [
    { "type": "quant", "format": "int8", "expected_delta": 0.12, "confidence": 0.82 },
    { "type": "batch", "batch_size": 8, "expected_delta": 0.06 }
  ]
}
```

ada: telemetry ask — recommender decisions need associated traces and eval samples stored for 30d. ops needs a storage cost estimate before we sign off. can infra estimate?

marta: infra estimate needed, + product to own acceptance doc. updated scope after feedback: set alert default 10% with plan to tighten; add audit trail; include mobile heuristics in phase 1 but with limited rollout. Can we get greenlight by EOD Friday so we can kick off tickets?

nate: I can own the audit trail work and the API surface for the UI. happy to pair on acceptance criteria. +1 from me.

sam: +1 from infra side, will follow up with specific SLO mapping (p95 for interactive, p99 for sync batch) and a short doc. :thumbsup:

marta: thanks — I'll update the deck and CLN-42 with these edits. tagging @jun/ada for any last minute asks. planning sync tomorrow 10:30am PT.

ada: noted. if infra can provide the cost estimate by Wed we can confirm phase-1 rollout windows.

jun: will prep the offline eval harness and sample dataset.

marta: perfect — closing for now.
